faculty.name: Shakeel Ahmed Bhatti
faculty.bio: Shakeel Ahmed Bhatti leads BM Grammar School as its Principal, overseeing the school’s campuses and its Montessori-to-Matric programme. A full biography will be published by the school office.

faqs.question: Which classes does BM Grammar School offer?
faqs.answer: The school provides education from Montessori through Matric, covering early years, primary, middle and secondary levels, including Matriculation preparation.

faqs.question: Are classes separate for boys and girls?
faqs.answer: Yes. The school provides separate classes for boys and girls, with a positive and disciplined learning environment.

faqs.question: Is there an admission fee?
faqs.answer: Admission is free. Families can start an application online through this website or visit any campus office for assistance.

faqs.question: Where are the school’s campuses located?
faqs.answer: BM Grammar School serves families from three campuses: Al Sadaf Colony, Mominabad and Orangi Town, Karachi. The documented Orangi Town campus address is Plot No. 518, Sector No. 4/F, Islam Nagar, Orangi Town.

faqs.question: How do I apply for admission?
faqs.answer: Choose “Apply Online”, create a parent account, select a campus and class, complete the student and guardian details, and submit. You will receive a reference number such as BM-2026-XXXXXX to track the application from your dashboard.

faqs.question: How can I track my admission application?
faqs.answer: Sign in and open your dashboard. Every application shows its current status: Submitted, Under Review, Accepted or Rejected.

faqs.question: What is the Monthly Open House?
faqs.answer: The school holds a Monthly Open House where parents meet teachers and review student progress. A larger Open House event is also held at Ali Baba Stadium, Orangi Town No. 4. Dates are announced by the school office.

faqs.question: How can I contact the school?
faqs.answer: Call the school office on 0312-2690757, write through the contact form on this website, or email bmgsone1@yahoo.com.
